display_name: Phase1 rollout conditional transport source validation
description: Fixed source-only receiver/scenario validation of the four-step-trained conditional IQ transport; evaluate 1/4/8 inference steps.
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU2 source-only fixed model evaluation; TF32 disabled

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256], six frozen class-conditional posterior waveform hypotheses; candidate F feature/probability, predicted noise and forward residual
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No true source labels used in evaluation; U_s truth, V and test not read
data.validation_ref: 7840 RX4/6 source validation and 3921 RX8 source holdout IDs, all physical IDs previously observed in other views; frozen clean F pseudo labels only

permissions.query_use: Only source fit L_s truth and U_s high-confidence clean F pseudo targets; no U_s truth/V/test
permissions.claim_scope: Source source IDs used by F and seen in other channel views, pseudo targets not independent test; bounded correction may exploit classifier

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen four-step-trained conditional transport, blind parent, Tri-SIG-TIME SSL, source priors and input protection gate; DURA is source reference only.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Transport checkpoint SHA256 c47bb4ad18cd31e3e06e7e92f1faee4262cee74e599ebdd246a061425cd243ec; blind parent and source prior exact checks in code.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Predeclared 1/4/8 transport steps and 0.8/0.99 input gates; RX4/6 source validation versus parent and DURA, per-cell classification and aligned IQ guards, at least 10 net source gains; RX8 source holdout; no automatic test.
